title: Hoffman colorability of graphs with smallest eigenvalue at least -2
summary: In accordance with the Cameron-Goethals-Seidel-Shult Classification Theorem, we extend the characterization of Hoffman colorability of line graphs from (Abiad, Bosma, Van Veluw, 2025) to all connected graphs with smallest eigenvalue at least $-2$; we give a characterization of Hoffman colorability of generalized line graphs, and we completely classify the Hoffman colorable exceptional graphs.
